# What is this?

This section contains a couple of work-in-progress sketches of potential future
chapters. I leave them here in case I need to refer to some specific contents or
functions during my teaching, but in general, I recommend you don't spend too
much effort looking at this. The exercises and code examples have not been
proofread, may contain mistakes, or be even conceptually wrong. Whether they
make it into the final version of the book or not hasn't been decided yet.
